question: The volume (in m³) of a cuboidal tank with dimensions 13 { m} times 4 { m} times 9 { m} is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The volume of a cuboidal tank can be found directly by multiplying its dimensions.

Volume = Length × Breadth × Height

Volume = 13 × 4 × 9 = 468 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 468 m³.**
